final_message:
I built the Ploverdesk landing page and wrote its design system to MASTER.md. **I could not build or type-check it:** this sandbox has no Node (`npm` is blocked and `node` is not found), so `npm run build` never ran. I reviewed the TypeScript by reading it, and none of the motion or layout has been seen in a browser.

## What I built
- **`MASTER.md`**: the design system and both theses below.
- **`src/styles/tokens.css`**: every color, size, spacing and timing value, taken from MASTER.md.
- **`src/index.css`**: all page styles.
- **`src/App.tsx`** and **`src/components/MatchTable.tsx`**: the page. `index.html` got a real title and description, and `public/favicon.svg` is new.
- **`preview/thesis.html`** and **`preview/design-system.html`**: standalone previews of the direction and the design system. Throwaway, not the build.

The page, top to bottom: a header with "Book a demo" and "Start the 14-day trial". Then the hero:
- headline and a short paragraph;
- the trial button, with "No credit card needed.";
- an example invoice checked line by line against the order and the delivery note, as a real table labelled "Illustrative example, not customer data".

After the hero come how an invoice moves through Ploverdesk, the three things that stop an invoice, export (CSV or API) and Frankfurt hosting, the price, who makes it (founded 2025, six people in Rotterdam, no logos yet), and a footer.

The trial button has the same label everywhere and links to /trial. The demo link stays quiet and goes to /demo. The only figures are from your brief, plus the example quantities in the labelled table.

## The direction (UNVALIDATED: nobody was there to approve it)
- **Look:** a cool near-white page in near-black ink, with one color, a deep amber that only ever marks a line that doesn't match. Type is the system font (no web font, since there's no network), regular and medium weights only, with numbers aligned in columns. Thin rules instead of boxes, 2px corners, no shadows.
- **Motion:** hovers change color or underline in 150ms. Nothing moves on scroll. There is one animation: on load, the matched rows of the example table fade back to grey one after another, leaving the mismatched line standing. With reduced motion turned on, the table simply appears in its final state.
- **Approaches I set aside:** the usual SaaS page (gradient hero, dashboard screenshot, logo strip, three feature cards); its opposite, a page with one giant headline and nothing else; a product dashboard; a spreadsheet grid. I kept the invoice, order and delivery note read against each other.

## What I checked
- **Audit script:** it ran 28 checks and flagged one, a hover state with no transition. That's a false positive: the transitions are declared at `src/index.css:58` and `:83`.
- **Design-tell checks** (invented figures, decoration, em dashes, gradients, glow and the like): none found.
- **Contrast,** computed from the token values: body text 17.49:1, secondary text 6.64:1, the faded matched rows 5.35:1, the amber mismatch 6.18:1 on its tint and 6.69:1 on the page, white on the buttons 10.29:1 or more.
- **Reduced motion** is handled at `src/index.css:292`.
- **Visible focus ring** on every link and button.
- **Disabled styling** exists for both button types, though nothing on the page is disabled.
- **Only opacity and color animate,** never layout properties, and no animation loops.
- **Tokens:** I removed two hard-coded values I found. The four screen-width breakpoints stay literal because CSS can't use variables there.
- **Layout:** a two-column arrangement repeats in three sections. The other sections use different layouts so the page isn't one repeated template.

## Still to run (UNVERIFIED)
- `npm run build`, which includes the TypeScript check.
- Chrome DevTools Performance while the table animates: no frame over 16.7ms.
- The page at 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px wide: no horizontal scroll. The table scrolls inside its own area below 36rem.
- The page with the system's reduce-motion setting on.

Modules loaded: tells, ui-ux-pro-max, motion-principles, css-native, mobile-principles, design-audit
Modules not loaded: none
